summary: Namib Minerals filed a Form 6-K on July 7, 2026, announcing board and executive changes: Tulani Sikwila elected Chairman (continues as CEO, no longer CFO); Siphesihle Mchunu appointed CFO (previously General Counsel, remains director); Wendy Luhabe appointed Class III director effective July 3, replacing Ibrahima Tall (resigned June 3, 2026). Luhabe, with over 30 years of experience, will serve as lead independent director and on compensation committee, with term expiring at 2028 AGM. These are orderly leadership transitions, not forced departures. The changes reflect governance strengthening rather than a special situation event. No extraordinary terms, recommendations, or structural mechanics are disclosed. What to watch: future strategic moves under new leadership structure.
